title: Notifications
inboxDescription: Every update that concerns you, in one place.
emptyBody: Important updates will show up here as they happen.

invitation_accepted.title: {name} joined
invitation_accepted.body: {name} accepted your invitation and created an account.

file_shared.title: New file: {file}
